Name: Pet Chickadee-Hummingbird
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
I love chickadees (if you couldn't tell by my username XD), and I finally am modding them into the game. This is simply a cat retexture to a chickadee. The sprites are free use by [url=https://pop-shop-packs.itch.io/]Pop Shop Packs on itch.io[/url]. They are wonderful, thank you so much for creating these assets! To get the pet chickadee, simply use the scissors on your pet cat. It will still meow, because it is just a retexture. I think it is adorable.

The chickadee can fly backwards, due to how I placed the sprites, but I consider this a feature, not a bug. Just imagine it is a hummingbird-chickadee hybrid.

Downloads.Description: Adds a pet chickadee-hummingbird hybrid as a retexture of the cat.
